name: Alan
source:
A teacher volunteered to teach music to the children at Yuen Kong Kindergarten kindergarten.
However, behind her back, he was taking pictures of the children in sensational poses and posting them on a members-only image-posting social networking site run by Ash.
Shawn finds out about it and Cherie fires her, but he is not happy about it and storms into the kindergarten to protest.
